title: Rams WR Puka Nacua is listed as doubtful for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua is listed as doubtful for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos
sources.description: According to Sarah Barshop, who covers the Los Angeles Rams for ESPN, star WR Puka Nacua did not practice for a third straight day on Friday and was later listed as doubtful for Sunday Night’s game vs. the Broncos by the Rams.
